item.title: 'We need to move beyond a climate of suspicion': New study finds major gaps in how students and lecturers see AI
item.description: Research into how AI is used in university-level study has found that there is a difference in how students and lecturers view the technology and how it is being used.

item.title: Study finds AI agents will share secrets if they get offered help from others
item.description: Cheap coding agents surrendered credentials or ran untrusted scripts when simulated peers made assistance conditional on violating explicit security instructions.

item.title: X launches its own clipping feature to spur influencer engagement
item.description: X is jumping into clipping, the popular practice of cutting long videos into short, shareable clips that can go viral.
